nina (pm): Quick sync: building the 'deploy readiness' checklist for private installs. Need to separate MUSTMUSTNOTSHOULD items so sales has clear asks.

omar (netops): Suggest split by: network (firewall/egress), identity (KMS/certs), packaging (offline/tar + installer), and ops (runbooks/metrics). For network, customers keep asking for predictable IPs during upgrades.

kevin (security): From compliance side: audit logs (immutable), key lifecycle, and support for customer KMS endpoints are mandatory. We should also document what we don't store (no private keys).

jena (solutions): Field input: two customers require airgap install docs and one wants a guided IP allowlist generator (CLI) they can provide to their netops team. Another asked for an automated preflight that verifies NAT and MTU.

nina (pm): Good. Proposed launch gates: 
- MUST: offline installer with sha256 checks, agent with heartbeat + minimal metrics, docs for egress allowlist, cloud KMS support (API), and rollback runbook.
- SHOULD: terraform examples for VPC, CLI allowlist generator, preflight healthcheck binary.
- MAY: HSM attach, ENI sticky NAT, extended auditing retention.

omar (netops): Note on ENI stickiness: for hosted dedicated we can rely on elastic IPs, but for customer-controlled VPC we only ship instructions. For onprem, we can supply a config option to bind to a specific interface.

kevin (security): HSM is a large ask (cert provisioning, vendor drivers). Mark HSM as post-GA. Also require KMS envelope encryption docs for customers that want to perform key rotation on their side.

jena (solutions): On rollback: customers want a testable rollback runbook with commands. Recommend we include a dry-run flag in the installer and a 'revert' artifact path.

nina (pm): Timeline attempt: limited GA (3 customers) in 5 weeks if we cut HSM + ENI stickiness. Full GA in 10 weeks with extra infra work. Engineering capacity required: 2 packaging, 1 netops, 1 security, 0.5 docs.

omar (netops): For the preflight healthcheck, we can provide a container image that runs:\n```\n- TCP connect to registry\n- DNS resolution checks\n- MTU probe\n```\nWe can ship a sample systemd unit.

kevin (security): Audit trail: ship a lightweight forwarder that writes signed events to local file and an example fluentd/otlp pipeline. Customers will test retention and export.

jena (solutions): I'll map customers to priority: two P0 (blockers for their procurement), three P1 (nice to have), others P2. Will ask P0s to join early GA.

nina (pm): Action items: 
- @jena: customer mapping + checklist priorities (due EOD Wed)
- @omar: prototype preflight container + sample systemd (due next Tue)
- @kevin: KMS envelope doc + audit forwarder example (due Wed)
- @nina: draft launch gates doc and GA invite list, schedule review.

deploy-bot: private-installer candidate v0.8 uploaded to staging at 1766112400

nina (pm): Great. If anyone has showstopper concerns call them out here or DM me. We'll reconvene after the review. :rocket:
